operations.name: Create Bulk Unified Exclusion
operations.description:
Create Bulk Exclusions to make your Agents suppress alerts and mitigation for items that you consider to be benign or which you require for interoperability.
IMPORTANT! Every Exclusion is a possible security hole. Do not create Exclusions unless you are sure this hash, path, certificate signer, file type, or browser is always benign.
Of course, if you can make the Exclusion by its hash or path, that is much more secure than excluding all detections of a specific signer, file type, or browser. We do not recommend the last types for Exclusions on production endpoints. These Exclusions might be helpful in a lab or pentester group. When you create an Exclusion, make sure you set the filter to the smallest possible scope. For example, if you can exclude security for this item on a group, do not enter values for siteIds or accountIds.
We recommend that you read "Not Recommended Exclusions and Best Practices for Exclusions.
See the Help from the Console for more details.

operations.name: Get Exclusions
operations.description:
Get a list of all the Exclusions that match the filter.
Note: To filter the results for a scope:
* Global - Make sure "tenant" is "true" and no other scope ID is given.
* Account - Make sure "tenant" is "false" and at least one Account ID is given.
* Site - Make sure "tenant" is "false" and at least one Site ID is given.

query.description: If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up execution time.

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".

query.name: sortOrder
query.description: Sort direction. Example: "asc".

query.name: source
query.description: List sources to filter by. Example: "user".

query.name: tagIds
query.description: List of tag IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: tags
query.description: Filter exclusions by their assigned tags. Given in form of a JSON where each key represents a tag key, and each value represents a list of string values to filter by. To filter by unassigned tag values, use __nin suffix in the tag key. Example: "{"key1": ["value1_1", "value1_2"], "key2__nin": ["value2"]}".

query.name: tagsByGroup
query.description: Group exclusions by their assigned tags. Given in form of a JSON where each key represents a tag key, and each value represents a list of string values to filter by. . Example: "{"key1": ["value1_1", "value1_2"], "key2": ["value2"]}".

query.name: tenant
query.description: Indicates a tenant scope request

query.name: threatType
query.description: List of threat types to filter by. Example: "EDR".

query.name: updatedAt__between
query.description: Date range for update time (format: <from_timestamp>-<to_timestamp>, inclusive). Example: "1514978890136-1514978650130".

query.name: updatedAt__gt
query.description: Updated after this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__gte
query.description: Updated after or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lt
query.description: Updated before this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: updatedAt__lte
query.description: Updated before or at this timestamp. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: user__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by username.

query.name: userIds
query.description: List of user IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: value__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by value.

query.name: warnings
query.description: List of warnings to filter by. Example: "Not allowed".
